question: Does the public lead that Zhao Wanli's 《〈永乐大典〉展览的意义》 appeared in Shanghai 《文汇报》 on 1951-08-18 open a new lawful original-periodical route, and what can be closed without seeing the target newspaper page?
answer: Yes, but only at the physical-holding/discovery level. Shanghai Academy of Social Sciences Library's first-party old-newspaper directory directly closes a Shanghai 《文汇报》 holding covering all of 1951 and separately lists 《文汇报(香港)》 with only 1951 January-March, so the Shanghai/Hong Kong title ambiguity is controlled. A Tsinghua alumni institutional retrospective independently corroborates that in 1951 Zhao Wanli hosted the Yongle Dadian exhibition and wrote 《〈永乐大典〉展览的意义》, but it does not state an August 18 date or Wenhui venue. The secondary chronology page that supplied the 1951-08-18 Shanghai Wenhui lead is not directly reproducible from the GitHub runner under the tested public HTTP/HTTPS routes. No 1951-08-18 newspaper page or article text has been reviewed, so publication date/venue remains a secondary lead pending a primary newspaper image or equivalent first-party page-level object. The relationship between any Wenhui version and 《文物参考资料》 vol.2 no.9 pp.221-233 remains unresolved.
